items.title: P&G CFO on Q4 earnings: Consumers are 'responding to innovation'
items.summary: Procter & Gamble (PG) stock takes a dip on Wednesday after missing fourth quarter revenue expectations ($21.2 billion vs. estimates of $21.38 billion). P&G CFO Andre Schulten speaks with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about the latest trends in consumer buying and whether North American shoppers reflect those trends.

items.title: Gillette India posts quarterly profit rise on steady demand for grooming products

items.title: Q3 Estimates Increase for Tech and Finance, Fall for Consumer Staples
items.summary: The pressure on Consumer Staples directly reflects the exhaustion of sector pricing power. Procter & Gamble's (PG) recent earnings miss and conservative outlook underscore escalating consumer pushback against price hikes, which had previously driven sales growth and margin expansion.
